text:
maria: Heads-up — customer (ACME) hit a big spike of 503s hitting hosted inference around 12:44 UTC. Support ticket #45678. Initial triage points to upstream worker container crashes (GPU OOM + segfault) under a large-context workload.

devon: Oncall — any quick mitigations? Customers are seeing retries/timeouts and user sessions are impacted.

sam: I'm on it, scaling the pool now. Can we route their traffic to a smaller model variant while we investigate?

maria: Copying logs from the failing pod (stdout & dmesg snippet):
```
[2026-03-17T12:43:12Z] runtime: allocate failed: attempted to allocate 2147483648 bytes
[2026-03-17T12:43:12Z] nvidia: out of memory on device 0 (required 2.0GiB)
[2026-03-17T12:43:12Z] infer-runner[pid=2483]: segfault at 0x00000000 ip 0x7f4a1c2b8d c 0x7f4a1c2b8d sp 0x7ffdf1a3
[2026-03-17T12:43:13Z] kubelet: killing container infer-runner due to crashLoopBackOff
```

sam: Restart counter shows 6 restarts in 90s for that pod. Repro notes: workload was a long prompt (~40k tokens after preprocessing) with batch_size=6 on quantized_v2 model. Staging repro attempt queued.

devon: Mitigation now: routing rule added to send ACME traffic to r-infer-small (safer memory profile) in us-west-2 and temporarily reduced max_batch_size to 2 for that route. Also scaled dedicated pool +1 GPU. Monitoring latency/500s now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: route-change applied by sam at 2026-03-17T12:51Z — fallback routing -> r-infer-small (us-west-2).

infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled dedicated-pool-42 replicas from 3 -> 4 at 2026-03-17T12:52Z.

maria: Next steps for RCA / actionable data: please collect and attach the following to ticket #45678 — full pod YAML, `kubectl logs --previous` for the crash container, `dmesg` from node, `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY`, and core dump (if present) under /var/crash. Also include model commit hash and quantization profile.

sam: On it. I'll run the narrow repro harness with the exact prompt + batch config on a staging node (same driver CUDA 12.2 / NVIDIA 535.54). If we can reproduce, we'll try forcing KV-prefetch=false and/or revert quantized_v2 -> quantized_v1 to see if memory toll drops.

devon: Customer updated: "We've switched you to a lower-memory model variant and are monitoring; will follow up with RCA." ETA 2h for a full follow-up.

maria: Tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for model/runtime review. I've uploaded initial logs to s3://redwood-incident-logs/45678/4571239876/ and the k8s artifacts to /mnt/logs/incidents/4571239876. Good triage so far, team.
